summary: Defines the SiteDocument entity for associating documents with specific sites. Used in site management and document display.
purpose: Store metadata for documents related to a Site, enabling lookup and management of documents by SiteID.

summary: Manages staff admin welcome page and shows user last login, site and discipline dropdowns, date filters, and validation. Displays student employment applications.
purpose: Provides a landing page for staff admins, enabling them to filter and view employment applications by site, discipline, and date, with validation and management.

workflows.name: View Employment Applications
steps: Select Site from dropdown
Select Discipline from dropdown
Set Start Date and End Date (with validation)
Click Refresh View
View filtered applications in grid

business_rules: Start Date and End Date are required and validated.
Custom validation ensures Start Date is before End Date.
Withdrawn applications can be toggled in view.
Email link setup based on presence of applicant's email address.
Status and Withdrawn date display logic based on database values.
conditions: If email is missing, no icon is shown.
If WithdrawnDate is null, status is 'Submitted'. Otherwise, 'Withdrawn'.
system_behavior: Dropdown populates from Sites and Disciplines per Agency.
Page setup includes scripts and last login display.
Page messages processed and JS variables setup.
content_gaps: No data model or explicit entity definition (besides UI fields).

summary: Defines ServiceCode entities with localized names, used for categorizing and describing services. Supports multi-language and selection by Course or Timetable.
purpose: Provide a structured, localizable categorization for services, supporting filtering and reporting.

workflows.name: List Service Codes
steps: Call ServiceCodeListAll to retrieve all codes based on session and language.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Course
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID with CourseID.

workflows.name: List Service Codes by Timetable
steps: Call ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with TimetableID.

business_rules: Names are localized to session's language.
system_behavior: Localize fields if session is in alt-language mode.
Return list of ServiceCodes per Course or Timetable.

summary: Tracks user actions and changes made to site profiles, with audit details including user, agency, and date.
purpose: Audit trail of site profile changes for compliance, review, and troubleshooting.

workflows.name: Search Site Profile History
steps: Call SiteProfileHistorySearch with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, session.
Fill list from database records.
Format audit details.

business_rules: Audit information includes user and agency, formatted for display.
Special formatting if system admin or original user differs.
conditions: If ByUserSysAdmin and ByUserID != ByOriginalUserID, display Support Team.

summary: Handles email popup document management including search and deletion with file and folder operations.
purpose: Enables management of email attachments/documents in popups, including file deletion.

workflows.name: Search Email Popup Documents
steps: Split DataInfo string, parse emails, populate list.

workflows.name: Delete Email Popup Document
steps: Split DataInfo string.
Delete file and containing folder if found.
Modify DataInfo to remove entry.

business_rules: File deletion attempts are wrapped with try/catch.
system_behavior: Returns updated DataInfo string after delete operation.

summary: Defines batch processing for department expenses, including add, update, delete, and search operations.
purpose: Manage grouped expense claims per department, track status and dates, and handle batch lifecycle.

workflows.name: Add Expense Batch
steps: Call Add with departmentID, description, batchDate.

workflows.name: Update Expense Batch
steps: Call Update with ID, description, batchDate, statusCodeID.

workflows.name: Delete Expense Batch
steps: Call Delete with batch ID.

workflows.name: Search Expense Batches
steps: Call Search with session and departmentID.

business_rules: BatchNumberFormatted is a composite of ID and status.

workflows.name: Get Cost Centre View
steps: Call GetCostCentre with filtering parameters.
Database stored procedure returns records.
Iterate records into CostCentreRecord objects.

summary: Manages assessment templates and workflows for student placements, including validation logic, assessor/subject types, and customizable fields.
purpose: Allows departments to configure, add, edit, and validate student assessment templates by timetable, tracking open/close days and who can view answers.

workflows.name: Configure Assessment Template
steps: Department sets up assessment template for timetable.
Select assessor type, subject type, assessment type, assessment template.
Set open and close days, view permissions, and optional section.
Validate and save configuration.
System validates: interim without final, max assessments, instructor/supervisor conflict.

workflows.name: Add/Edit/Delete Timetable Assessment
steps: Add: Switch to add mode, enter fields, save.
Edit: Switch to edit mode, change fields, save.
Delete: Confirm, remove assessment.

business_rules: Must have final if interim is present.
Instructor and supervisor assessments conflict warning.
validations: Required fields: open days, close days, assessment template.
Custom validator for close days after placement.
conditions: If screen is editable and no data, show add button.
If subject is supervisor, allow subject to view assessor answers.
system_behavior: Page messages surfaced in error/warning panels.
Permissions and screen-editability determined by user role.
exceptions: JavaScript errors on event validation for EmptyDataTemplate.
content_gaps: Explicit data model for TimetableAssessment entity not shown, but inferred from fields and UI.
Assessment validation rules are surfaced but not fully documented in business logic.

steps: Call DataReaderToHTMLTable with SqlDataReader.
Build header row from field names.
Iterate rows, output each field's value.
Return HTML string.

summary: Defines and manages student prerequisite records for infection control, immunization, confidentiality, and occupational health. Supports update and validation workflows with extensive field coverage.
purpose: Tracks health, safety, and confidentiality prerequisites for students, enabling department compliance and workflow automation.

workflows.name: Update Student Infection Control
steps: Validate StudentPrerequisite for N95 mask and solution.
Update database with new infection control values.

workflows.name: Update Student Occ Health Summary
steps: Validate prerequisite record.
Update database with occupational health values.

workflows.name: Update Confidentiality Status
steps: Validate record.
Update database with confidentiality form and notes.

workflows.name: Update Immunization Occ Health
steps: Validate and map values.
Update database with vaccination details and notes.

workflows.name: Safety Updates (CRC, IDCard, WCB)
steps: Validate safety prerequisites.
Update CRC, IDCard, WCB values in database.

business_rules: All dates must be valid and within maximum years (typically 5 years).
Certain fields become mandatory depending on others (expiry dates, mask sizes, etc.).
Year fields are validated to be within plausible ranges.
Vaccination fields and notes are required depending on status.
validations: Date fields checked for ranges and validity.
Expiry date must be present if mask expiry years are specified.
Mandatory fields checked for consent and dates.
Year fields checked for plausible values.
calculations: TetanusExpiryDate calculated as 10 years after admin date unless provided.
Highlight expiring items in red if close.
system_behavior: Record returned empty if none found.
Various update methods set parameters and execute database procedures.
